chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Shuayb Al Aqarquqy, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him fulfil [his promise] when he promises'.

key_terms.يَوْمِ الْآخِرِ: The Last Day / Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the connection between faith and keeping promises in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith establishes promise-keeping (al-wa'd) as a fundamental marker of Iman, linking theological belief directly to ethical conduct. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as the basis for the binding nature of contracts and vows, emphasizing that breaking a promise is not merely a social faux pas but a spiritual deficiency that contradicts the reality of one's faith.
